liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight/** (3 reviews): Pigpen sings with great energy, over a basic early jam; Great jamming, even though the recording has a cut [5][14][15]
- **The Other One** (3 reviews): An early version whose story lyrics tell of being busted for smiling on a sunny day; Reviewer counts this among favorite versions and likes Bobby's original lyrics [5][8][16]
- **Cold Rain And Snow** (2 reviews): Played fast, in the manner of the first LP; Very fast early version that stands out to the reviewer [12][14]
- **That's It For The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the best version of the song they have heard; Reviewer calls it the first-known performance of the suite; somewhat tentative in spots, including Bobby's early lyrics [9][14]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Shows a bluesy side of Jerry that reviewer finds more authentic than anything heard before [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Cryptical Reprise**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 9 archived performances [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1967-10-22.116228.sbd.kaplan.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 9 songs; 55 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.yerys.1525.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 54 min; rated 4.2/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd67-10-22.sbd.miller.18101.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 45 min; rated 4.2/5 by 40 [4]. Said about its sound: There is a sound problem at the beginning of the recording; the remainder is fine; Reviewer finds the sound quality very good for 1967; Sound quality varies through the show, with Lovelight among the better-sounding parts [4][11][13][15]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.miller.116257.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 55 min; rated 4.85/5 by 13 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the lyric refers to Bobby dropping a water balloon on a cop from a third floor, after the October pot bust at 710 [5]
- Reviewer recalls this as a benefit for the bust, with Quicksilver and Big Brother also playing [7]
- Reviewer recalls Owsley's purple acid circulating, with many naked people running around [7]
- Reviewer says Jerry could not play the second set, so Big Brother played three sets [7]
- The end of Lovelight is missing; uploader seeks an audience tape to fill it [2]
- Reviewer wonders if this is the earliest archive recording with Mickey, who joined 9/29/67, but cannot hear him [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1967-10-22.116228.sbd.kaplan.flac16**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: SBD > Master Reels > DAT; Lineage/Recording Info detail/Editing detail: SBD > Master Reels > DAT (Panasonic 3700) > Sound card (Delta DiO 2496) > PC hard drive… [1]. Also: Made from discs from an anonymous source; this version eliminates the analog cassette generation; audio was normalized and cleaned up [1]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.yerys.1525.shnf**: transferred by SHN Encode and Upload: Ben Yerys; source: SBDmR>Cass>DAT>Sonic Solutions via D. Gans>CDR [2]. Also: Seeded by Gans, so the uploader assumes this is all that exists from the vault [2]
- **gd67-10-22.sbd.miller.18101.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Normalized and cleaned up in Samplitude, with no noise reduction, unlike the earlier No Noise shn circulating copy [4]
- **gd1967-10-22.sbd.miller.116257.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat [3]
- Soundboard to master reels to DAT [18]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1967-10-22 Winterland Arena, San Francisco, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1967-10-22-winterland-arena-san-francisco-ca-usa/) [23]
- Fan art by Mari Tepper: [Grateful Dead Big Brother Quicksilver Winterland 1967 AOR 2.205 Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/1368138/Grateful-Dead-Big-Brother-Quicksilver-Winterland-1967-AOR-2205-Concert-Poster) [24]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [current-page:url:arg:3 | Grateful Dead](https://www.dead.net/tags/winterland) [25]
